assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: top-down 2D gameplay environment prop, isolated transparent PNG source. Primary request: one compact industrial generator skid for a survival game service yard. It is a single object, centered, viewed FRONT-ORTHOGRAPHIC from directly above in the game's 2.5D top-down view: long straight horizontal front-facing edges, vertical posts, a narrow rectangular visible top band; no isometric perspective and absolutely no diagonal side or end face. Subject details: muted teal and weathered blue-gray steel generator casing, two dark exhaust vents, small amber warning lamp and restrained amber safety brackets, readable engine panel shapes and bolts, sturdy low skid feet. Pixel-art with crisp deliberately chunky clusters and dark outlines; match the supplied reference images' muted steel/teal palette, pixel scale, straight-on top-down projection, and restrained amber edge accents. Composition: footprint fills most of a 128x96 logical canvas without cropping, keep clear silhouette and a small support at bottom-center. Transparent background. No floor, cast shadow, scenery, people, text, labels, logo, watermark. Preserve clean pixel edges; no soft gradients or blur.
